dedupe_keys.name: two multi temporal datasets to track debris flow after the 2008 wenchuan earthquake

description: Two multi-temporal datasets to track debris flow after the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Lei Wang et al. We provide two datasets for tracking the debris flow induced by the 2008 Wenchuan Mw 7.9 earthquake on a section of the Longmen mountains on the eastern side of the Tibetan plateau (Sichuan, China). Coverage: national (CN); published in 2022. Formats: Excel, TXT, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
